Why work at Hyro

Unique individuals, one tight-knit team.

  • I love how our ‘win as a team’ motto is truly reflected in our daily work.  This motto isn’t a poster on the wall here.  When I’ve been stuck, people from other teams have dropped what they were doing to help, and nobody kept score.  It happens often enough that I’ve stopped being surprised by it.

    Mike Kubo Head of FDS

  • The first time I heard that an older patient told one of our AI agents ‘thank you, you’ve been really helpful’, it landed differently. That’s the kind of moment that makes this role different from any other engineering role I’ve had.

    Adi Rosenbaum Senior Software Engineer

  • Gen AI is moving fast. Hyro gives me the opportunity to stay at the forefront of it, with access to the latest AI tools, continuous learning, and people who are pushing the technology forward. I feel like I’m not just adapting to what’s next, I’m helping build it and turn it into products that make a real impact.

    Shany Hordan Product Manager

  • Leadership shares the numbers in company meetings, wins and misses both, then actually listens when we weigh in. I’ve raised things with my manager and watched them turn into real change. That’s ‘open book’ in practice, and why this feels like my company too, not just my job.

    Nelson Gildener Senior Product Marketing Manager

  • The moment I showed curiosity about a skill outside my role, I was pointed to the person who could teach it to me and given the time to learn. That is ‘squeeze the lemon’ in practice: turning a raised hand into a new skill.

    Mimi El-Messidi Manager, Engagement Management

Limitless growth

Benefits built to power your best work yet.

Our benefits reflect what we believe in: you’ll tap into your best self when you’re valued, trusted to make an impact, and surrounded by others who care as much as you do.

Explore our values

  • Impact from day one

    Real ownership from the start, on work that reaches patients right away.

  • Personal growth, built in

    Mentorship, development budget, and real career paths as we scale.

  • Flexibility that fits your life

    Hybrid and remote options, flexible time off, and long weekends on us.

  • Recognized, and rewarded

    Competitive pay, top-tier gear, and perks built to match your work.

  • Backed for the long run

    $95M in funding means room to build, not looking over your shoulder.

  • Vibrant team culture

    Trips, happy hours, unlimited snacks and a dog-friendly workplace to unwind in.

  • Room to stand out

    Supported networking and speaking opportunities to build your personal brand.

  • Parental and family support

    Dedicated time and space to prioritize what matters most.

FAQ

  • The process varies by role, but you can generally expect a call with our HR team, a manager interview, a skills assessment, and a final conversation with an executive and HR. The goal is mutual fit: for us to get to know you, and for you to get a real sense of what the day-to-day actually looks like.

  • Hybrid, with some fully remote roles, the job description will tell you which applies. Our hubs are in Tel Aviv and New York City, and three days in the office keep the collaboration real.

  • Most roles move from first call to offer in about three weeks, though it can run longer depending on the role.

  • Flexible time off, paid sick leave, a meal stipend, quarterly company-wide long weekends, the option to work from anywhere for up to two weeks a year, and a dog-friendly office.

  • Yes. Submit your CV above and we’ll reach out when a match opens up.

  • We’re 170 SuperHyros, building AI agents that turn healthcare’s chaos into care. Small enough that your work is visible, big enough that it matters.
